application.name: Trail Notes
application.purpose: Publish fictional trail notes and approved visitor postcards without exposing pending contributions.

dependencies.note: The public application and its owner routes.
Versioned postcards/v1 create and approve API.
Owner session references only, never credentials.

evidence.summary: Primary owner Ada Nguyen; fallback Sam Okafor; last checked by the workspace owner.
99.4% successful public reads against a 99.5% target over seven days; one breach window.
Approved postcard remains absent from the public source; the owner moderation view still shows it as approved.
Unit and accessibility gates pass; the public-visibility gate fails; physical iOS input was not run.
Directional weekly export is flat; it is seven hours old and not a live bill.

Approval request returns 500 with a D1 NOT NULL violation after the trimmed text becomes empty; the captured authorization header is redacted to Bearer [REDACTED]. Captured header: Authorization: Bearer example.invalid.token.value
The owner approval route returns 200 when DEV_BYPASS=1 and no owner session is present.

signals.impact: Visitors can submit a postcard, but an approved postcard never appears on the public page. The owner can still moderate it in the Preview.

cost.note: Weekly provider export is seven hours old; directional only

defect.summary: Approving a postcard whose text becomes empty after trimming returns 500 instead of a validation error.
defect.expected: A validation response that keeps the postcard pending and explains the empty text.
defect.actual: 500 from the approval handler with a D1 NOT NULL violation; the pending record is unchanged.
reproduction: Open the Preview as the fictional owner and select the pending postcard pc-1042.
Approve it; its body contains only spaces.
Observe the 500 response and the unchanged pending record.

gates.name: Phone and desktop accessibility
gates.expected: Keyboard focus and both themes usable at 390px and 1440px.
gates.actual: Checked in the Preview; no horizontal overflow.

gates.name: Approved postcard becomes public
gates.expected: Public source returns 200 with the approved postcard and status approved.
gates.actual: Public source returns 404 after approval; the pending record updates.

gates.name: Owner moderation remains private
gates.expected: A visitor is denied the owner moderation route.
gates.actual: Denied without a session outside the bypass case recorded in ev-07.

gates.name: Physical iOS keyboard and zoom
gates.expected: Physical device input and zoom behave as designed.
gates.actual: No physical device available in this fictional lab.

architecture.question: Should Trail Notes keep the shared postcards service binding, inline postcard moderation, or extract a shared client library?

options.label: Keep the versioned postcards/v1 service binding
options.tradeoff: One moderation boundary and one contract owner; releases need cross-service coordination.

options.label: Inline postcard moderation into the Trail Notes Worker
options.tradeoff: Simpler single deploy; creates a second moderation path and duplicates pending/approved rules.

options.label: Extract a shared client library
options.tradeoff: Type sharing without a network hop; couples deploy versions and hides the runtime failure boundary.

constraints: Publishing and moderation must stay one owner-controlled boundary.
The Preview must use isolated D1/R2/KV and no production service binding.
The postcards contract is versioned; a breaking change needs a new version.
No new provider or paid service is authorised by this decision.

accessPaths.protection: Public read; only published postcards are returned.
accessPaths.note: No owner data in the public payload.

accessPaths.protection: Rate-limited public create; records start pending.
accessPaths.note: Text-first; media remains disabled in this Preview.

accessPaths.protection: EmDash owner session behind Cloudflare Access.

findings.title: Preview owner approval route reachable with DEV_BYPASS=1
findings.exposure: A visitor could approve a pending postcard in the shared Preview.
findings.remediation: Remove the bypass, require the owner session, then retest denied and allowed paths.

findings.title: Redacted authorization header retained in a Preview log
findings.exposure: Rotation status is unconfirmed; the value is not reproduced in this bundle.
findings.remediation: Confirm rotation in the owner console and stop capturing the header.

change.scope: Prepare a defect patch, release review and drift report in the isolated Preview; no production effect.

release.notes: Rollback target rel-20261016-2. Postcard rows created after the release need a data-compatibility check; this plan does not restore deleted media.
